g.text: CIRCLES for AI: keep the skeleton, add the AI checks
general product knowledge, not from the vault sources
standard step
the AI addition
C Comprehend
Is AI the right tool? Deterministic or probabilistic?
What accuracy and latency are acceptable?
I Identify
Who sees the output, and who is hit by its errors?
Include the person who reviews or corrects it.
R Report
Add a trust story: rely on the answer without checking.
Add a failure-state story.
C Cut
Weigh value against data readiness, eval, cost per task.
No way to measure quality ranks lower.
L List
Automation level: suggestion, copilot or autonomous.
Include a human-in-the-loop option.
E Evaluate
Add quality distribution, hallucination risk, latency,
cost, privacy and fallback behaviour.
S Summarize
Add the launch plan (staged rollout, kill switch)
and the eval plan (golden set, online metrics).
three questions for any AI answer
1. What happens when the
model is wrong, and how does
the user recover?
2. What data does it need,
and do we have the right to
use it?
3. What does it cost per task,
and does the price fit
the value?
AI adds quality, data, failure and cost checks
